thesis: Bob Pittman argues that the vast majority of consumers are driven by an eternal quest for convenience, often prioritizing it over quality in their daily transactions. He illustrates this principle by explaining how his businesses, from Six Flags to AOL and MTV, succeeded by offering products that saved time or allowed users to pick and choose content on their own schedules.
